title: Server entry point, config loading, graceful shutdown
description: Create gophermind-server/main.go: flag/env parsing (port, token, WG config, LLM endpoint), config loading from gophermind-lib/config, signal handling, graceful shutdown. Wire up logging and metrics initialization.

SIGINT/SIGTERM trigger graceful shutdown (HTTP server drains, WG interface closes)
